cleardevDecision.title: Pending confirmation windows
cleardevDecision.help: Reopening displays the same pending decision. Only your choice in the native dialog can approve it.
cleardevDecision.waitingConnection: Waiting for the private desktop connection. A recorded reopen will wait for it.
cleardevDecision.desktopUnavailable: Open ClearDev in its desktop app to request this window.
cleardevDecision.changed: The original decision is no longer current; its history is retained.
cleardevDecision.unavailable: Confirmation facts could not be read. Refresh before requesting a window.
cleardevDecision.first: Waiting for the first confirmation window.
cleardevDecision.registered: Reopen recorded; waiting for the private channel to display it.
cleardevDecision.resolved: This decision has already been settled.
cleardevDecision.unknown: The response is unknown. Retrying uses the same original request.
cleardevBlocker.title: Current situation and how to proceed
cleardevBlocker.owner.HUMAN: A person must make a decision or resolve a known blocker
cleardevBlocker.owner.CONTROL_PLANE: The control program checks or observes the original step
cleardevBlocker.owner.BUILDER: The original Builder repairs or continues the task
cleardevBlocker.owner.REVIEWER: An independent reviewer checks the candidate
cleardevBlocker.owner.STEWARD: The project Steward resolves the planning question
cleardevBlocker.owner.NONE: No further action is currently required
cleardevBlocker.historical: Historical stop (not the current recovery target)
cleardevBlocker.previous: Previous round: a failure still relevant to the rework
cleardevBlocker.previousNotice: This is the preceding candidate's check, not a new failure of the current step. Restoring a session does not fix this candidate.
cleardevBlocker.limit: Why this operation cannot proceed yet
cleardevBlocker.noDetail: This diagnosis has not obtained a more detailed cause for the exact stop. The code identifies a failure class, not proof of a particular network, account, or machine fault. Check its original session or record; missing display detail does not prove no detail was saved.
cleardevBlocker.readError: The detailed diagnosis could not be read. Do not treat an empty explanation as a repaired environment. Refresh; the recovery service still validates every operation.
cleardevBlocker.stale: The current source or facts cannot be confirmed. Refresh before following a recovery recommendation. Old records remain evidence of history, not current permission.
cleardevBlocker.guidanceOnly: These instructions do not grant permission. Only the current operations listed below can be requested; budget and human approvals still apply.
cleardevBlocker.noOperation: No safe continuation is currently offered. Follow the evidence checks below; do not clear records or repeatedly create new requests. An unsupported recovery requires a product fix, not a claim that the environment is repaired.
cleardevBlocker.excerpt: Excerpt only. The complete original remains in the linked check or session record.
cleardevBlocker.sessionObservation: Session state is observed now; it does not establish why the historical session exited.
cleardevBlocker.fact.QUESTION: Question requiring an answer
cleardevBlocker.AUTH.title: Account authentication is required
cleardevBlocker.AUTH.cause: The selected tool/provider could not authenticate. A running desktop application does not prove that this provider account is signed in.
cleardevBlocker.AUTH.risk: Pasting credentials into a recovery explanation exposes secrets; switching accounts or tools silently may change the authorized execution identity.
cleardevBlocker.AUTH.steps: Check the selected provider and its own login status on this machine. Complete login using that tool's normal interface, never in this text box. Refresh and run the existing preflight retry. Continue the original step only when its recovery action is offered.
cleardevBlocker.AUTH.done: A new preflight confirms the same bound tool/model is usable. Recovery still requires its own accepted request and message evidence.
cleardevBlocker.TOOL.title: Tool, model, or configuration needs attention
cleardevBlocker.TOOL.cause: The executable, configuration, requested model, driver compatibility, or selected execution settings could not be validated. Read the exact reason; these are different faults.
cleardevBlocker.TOOL.risk: Blind upgrades or editing global configuration can affect unrelated sessions. An admitted workflow must not silently change its model or tool.
cleardevBlocker.TOOL.steps: Open the project's execution settings and inspect the current preflight detail. Verify the tool is installed and available to the app, its configuration parses, and the requested model is advertised. Use the existing configuration and preflight controls; after admission, preserve the original selection rather than forcing another provider.
cleardevBlocker.TOOL.done: Preflight passes for the intended bound settings, and the old step has a supported continuation. A local OpenCode configuration check alone is not proof of remote provider availability.
cleardevBlocker.PROVIDER.title: The provider or bound worker is unavailable
cleardevBlocker.PROVIDER.cause: The stored reason says a role/provider was unavailable; it does not by itself identify a network outage. Check the attempt, preflight, and original session evidence.
cleardevBlocker.PROVIDER.risk: Resending while delivery is unknown may create a second action. Repeated retries consume messages and can conceal the original failure.
cleardevBlocker.PROVIDER.steps: Inspect the original session and the provider error category. Resolve any specific account, connectivity, configuration, or quota problem shown. Respect a recorded retry time. If the original turn is still running or delivery is unknown, observe it instead of resending. Use the offered original-step recovery only after terminal failure is confirmed.
cleardevBlocker.PROVIDER.done: The original turn has a known outcome, prerequisites are usable, and one budgeted continuation receives a confirmed send.
cleardevBlocker.QUOTA.title: The provider account quota is exhausted
cleardevBlocker.QUOTA.cause: The model provider rejected work because its account quota was unavailable. This is separate from ClearDev's per-task message and round budgets.
cleardevBlocker.QUOTA.risk: Buying provider credits does not authorize extra ClearDev rounds; retrying before the account limit changes just repeats the failure.
cleardevBlocker.QUOTA.steps: Check usage and account limits in the provider's own interface. Wait for the limit to reset or make an explicit account decision. Then refresh/preflight and use the existing continuation. Do not reset ClearDev's budget records.
cleardevBlocker.QUOTA.done: The provider accepts the selected account/model and ClearDev separately confirms remaining workflow budget.
cleardevBlocker.RATE_LIMIT.title: Wait for the provider retry window
cleardevBlocker.RATE_LIMIT.cause: A rate limit or a not-yet-due retry is recorded. A waiting step is not necessarily a failed development attempt.
cleardevBlocker.RATE_LIMIT.risk: Rapid repeated clicks can make rate limits worse; changing request identities cannot legally reset the attempt budget.
cleardevBlocker.RATE_LIMIT.steps: Check the retry time below, wait, then refresh. Allow the existing bounded automatic retry to operate when eligible; use an explicit continuation only if the backend offers one. If no time was recorded, check the provider response rather than inventing a delay.
cleardevBlocker.RATE_LIMIT.done: The retry window has elapsed and a confirmed attempt advances the original step, with old failures retained.
cleardevBlocker.OBSERVING.title: The original action may still be running
cleardevBlocker.OBSERVING.cause: Observation timed out or a worker did not reply within the observation window. That does not prove the action failed or never ran.
cleardevBlocker.OBSERVING.risk: Resending or restarting the task can duplicate edits or external actions. A late original reply must not be replaced by a fresh request.
cleardevBlocker.OBSERVING.steps: View the original session and refresh the same step's status. Restore the connection needed to observe its existing turn, without sending a new development message. Only a confirmed terminal failure can be evaluated for the normal bounded recovery.
cleardevBlocker.OBSERVING.done: The same turn obtains a terminal result or a specific recorded failure; no second action is inferred from a timeout.
cleardevBlocker.UNKNOWN_DELIVERY.title: The previous outcome cannot be confirmed
cleardevBlocker.UNKNOWN_DELIVERY.cause: The send, execution, cleanup, or required identity/result evidence is incomplete. This safety gate is deliberately broader than a simple network error.
cleardevBlocker.UNKNOWN_DELIVERY.risk: Treating unknown as not executed can duplicate work. Deleting receipts, reservations, or leases destroys the evidence needed to recover safely.
cleardevBlocker.UNKNOWN_DELIVERY.steps: Refresh the original session and recovery history. A lost request response must reuse its exact request ID and content; an existing registration must be continued from history. If the original turn or container outcome still cannot be proved, stop resending and ask for diagnosis using the displayed fact IDs. Do not clear records to force a retry.
cleardevBlocker.UNKNOWN_DELIVERY.done: The original outcome and cleanup are confirmed from matching evidence, and the backend explicitly makes a safe action available.
cleardevBlocker.SESSION.title: The original worker cannot continue
cleardevBlocker.SESSION.cause: A bound worker could not be created, reconnected, or reused. Its present activity is shown below; the broad failure code alone does not preserve the historical low-level cause.
cleardevBlocker.SESSION.risk: A replacement chat may lose task identity and context. Clearing the original worktree can lose completed edits. Restoring the worker will not fix a preceding failed check.
cleardevBlocker.SESSION.steps: View the original session and verify its work directory and retained native identity. Resolve any explicit login/model/preflight fault. If the original unsent-step recheck is offered, request it directly; context is optional. The program checks prerequisites and attempts to restore the original session. Do not assert that code or the environment is fixed merely to enable a button. If native identity is missing, preserve the work and stop rather than create an unrelated session.
cleardevBlocker.SESSION.done: The original session is restored and the exact pending step receives one confirmed send. Any preceding check failure must still be repaired and checked again.
cleardevBlocker.FORMAT.title: The received result does not satisfy the protocol
cleardevBlocker.FORMAT.cause: A response arrived, but its JSON, required fields, text limits, or binding could not be accepted. Read the parser diagnostic rather than assuming the code is missing.
cleardevBlocker.FORMAT.risk: Manually changing stored JSON or truncating it may delete acceptance criteria or fabricate a successful result. A second mechanical correction must not be invented.
cleardevBlocker.FORMAT.steps: Inspect the saved parser error, including field path and length/byte limits. Use the existing one-time correction if it is still applicable. An offered Builder continuation keeps its work and spends a new authorized round; an offered compilation continuation reuses its remaining original-step attempt. Already settled invalid discussions or exhausted attempts have no universal same-step recovery. Preserve them and use only an explicitly supported next operation.
cleardevBlocker.FORMAT.done: A valid result is accepted under the same task/requirements, and normal checks and review still follow. A valid JSON object is not a PASS.
cleardevBlocker.INPUT.title: A real task question or blocker needs an answer
cleardevBlocker.INPUT.cause: The worker or planner requested information or reported a business blocker. This differs from a provider outage or invalid result format.
cleardevBlocker.INPUT.risk: An ambiguous answer can restart work without resolving the issue; supplementary text cannot approve a scope change or replace a specification.
cleardevBlocker.INPUT.steps: Read the saved question or worker/reviewer summary. Answer the actual unresolved question using the clarification form or offered continuation. Include concrete constraints or environment facts, not a generic 'fixed'. Scope or requirement changes must use their existing decision process. A Planner question with no supported answer operation needs an implementation fix, not a new invented retry.
cleardevBlocker.INPUT.done: The answer is saved against the original question/stop and the authorized next step advances without losing the old request.
cleardevBlocker.HUMAN.title: An explicit human decision is needed
cleardevBlocker.HUMAN.cause: The workflow is waiting for a bound specification, scope, or budget decision, or a previous decision was rejected. Waiting for approval is not an environment failure.
cleardevBlocker.HUMAN.risk: Text in this recovery panel is not approval. Reusing an expired or different decision can authorize the wrong version.
cleardevBlocker.HUMAN.steps: Find the pending decision and review its exact version, changes, and requested authority in the native window. Approve, reject, or defer there. If the human channel disconnected or expired, verify no active turn will be interrupted before restarting the desktop to reconnect; an old offer is not reusable. Never supply approval through this text box or an ordinary API.
cleardevBlocker.HUMAN.done: The current native decision is recorded and applied to the matching binding; the resulting workflow state is then re-read.
cleardevBlocker.BUDGET.title: A bounded attempt or message allowance has been reached
cleardevBlocker.BUDGET.cause: The applicable role, logical-step, discussion, planning, or rework allowance is exhausted. These counters are not interchangeable.
cleardevBlocker.BUDGET.risk: Clearing counters or choosing new request IDs conceals attempts and permits an unbounded loop. Provider account credit does not change these limits.
cleardevBlocker.BUDGET.steps: Check the exact used and remaining counters. Request extra allowance only when the backend offers it, and decide in the native window. An eligible original discussion or compilation may receive one additional original request after two confirmed failed attempts, followed by an explicit continuation. Approval does not continue the step, answer a blocker or confirm a specification. Other exhausted or settled steps keep their existing limits.
cleardevBlocker.BUDGET.done: A matching extra-round decision is recorded where supported, then one explicit eligible continuation advances. Old attempts and their counts remain visible.
cleardevBlocker.EVIDENCE.title: Required control or recovery evidence is incomplete
cleardevBlocker.EVIDENCE.cause: The recorded facts do not support a safe next step. An empty or generic stop code may also mean the original failure detail was never retained.
cleardevBlocker.EVIDENCE.risk: Inventing missing messages, replacing hashes, or manually setting a state to completed can turn an unverified candidate into a false success.
cleardevBlocker.EVIDENCE.steps: Check the original session, latest attempt/parse, relevant check, and pending decisions using their IDs. Refresh first. If evidence is genuinely absent or contradictory, keep the worktree and history and request a product-level diagnosis. There is no general force-unblock or ledger-reset operation.
cleardevBlocker.EVIDENCE.done: Matching original evidence is available and the existing gate admits a next action; otherwise the limitation remains explicit.
cleardevBlocker.SOURCE.title: The current source or binding cannot be confirmed
cleardevBlocker.SOURCE.cause: The source, specification, task set, candidate, or selected data baseline no longer matches, or the system could not read enough facts to confirm it. A failed read is not proof that the repository changed.
cleardevBlocker.SOURCE.risk: Retrying an old binding can apply work or approval to a different candidate. Resetting a repository to hide drift may destroy valid edits.
cleardevBlocker.SOURCE.steps: Refresh and compare the exact source, commit, current stage, and specification IDs. Restore access before deciding that a selection changed. Use the current source/delivery selection controls only for a deliberate new choice. Do not force an old recovery onto a new source or copy its PASS evidence.
cleardevBlocker.SOURCE.done: The intended current binding is confirmed, or a new explicit source choice is saved through its normal process. Old history remains unchanged.
cleardevBlocker.WORKTREE.title: The work directory or candidate cannot be safely used
cleardevBlocker.WORKTREE.cause: The directory, branch, commit ancestry, uncommitted work, or repository inspection did not satisfy the frozen task boundary.
cleardevBlocker.WORKTREE.risk: Reset, clean, recursive permission changes, or copying another candidate can lose work or make evidence refer to the wrong files.
cleardevBlocker.WORKTREE.steps: Inspect the named original directory and its Git status/HEAD without modifying it. Distinguish legitimate unfinished Builder edits from unexpected changes, missing paths, or access errors. Preserve a copy before any deliberate repair. Restore only the expected identity/access; a changed candidate needs the normal new-candidate checks, not reused evidence.
cleardevBlocker.WORKTREE.done: The original bound worktree and allowed unfinished edits are verified, or a properly authorized new candidate passes fresh checks.
cleardevBlocker.SCOPE.title: A path, permission, or generated-file boundary stopped work
cleardevBlocker.SCOPE.cause: The requested write, concurrent path use, or generated artifact does not match the approved scope and its required evidence.
cleardevBlocker.SCOPE.risk: Bypassing a scope gate or enabling blanket permissions can modify protected files, overlap another worker, or fabricate generated results.
cleardevBlocker.SCOPE.steps: Compare the actual path with the frozen write/forbidden/shared rules. An allowed scope question must use its existing decision request; a forbidden path is not released by a recovery explanation. Generated files need their exact approved command and proof. Permission dialogs must be assessed for their exact command/path, never automatically approved globally.
cleardevBlocker.SCOPE.done: The correct existing scope decision or generated proof is recorded and the normal gate accepts the work without weakening the rules.
cleardevBlocker.CHECK_FAILURE.title: The candidate failed a real check and needs repair
cleardevBlocker.CHECK_FAILURE.cause: The frozen candidate command failed, timed out, or an independent reviewer requested rework. A worker's own 'tests passed' statement does not override this result.
cleardevBlocker.CHECK_FAILURE.risk: Retrying the same unchanged candidate or disabling tests does not repair the defect. Changing a shared dependency directory or loosening the sandbox may violate the check contract.
cleardevBlocker.CHECK_FAILURE.steps: Read the exact candidate, command, exit code, and output below. Give the specific failure to the original Builder through the existing rework/continuation action. Preserve the failed check. For a native dependency error, verify the permitted build/output paths and matching runtime rather than guessing that reinstalling globally will help.
cleardevBlocker.CHECK_FAILURE.done: The Builder produces a new candidate, the same required checks run against it, and independent review accepts it. Restoring a session alone is not this result.
cleardevBlocker.CHECK_ENVIRONMENT.title: The check environment or safety validation failed
cleardevBlocker.CHECK_ENVIRONMENT.cause: CHECKER_UNAVAILABLE covers several cases: container/image or dependency preparation problems, resource failures, and some source-integrity safety refusals. The code alone cannot distinguish them.
cleardevBlocker.CHECK_ENVIRONMENT.risk: Blindly treating every infrastructure result as a repaired environment can rerun unknown work or bypass a source/command integrity failure.
cleardevBlocker.CHECK_ENVIRONMENT.steps: Inspect the exact check receipt and output. Verify Docker availability, the frozen local image, free storage/inodes, required dependency cache and supported lockfile, as indicated by that evidence. Integrity/path/manifest mismatches require source or implementation repair, not looser permissions. Request the offered same-candidate check retry only after its outcome and cleanup are confirmed.
cleardevBlocker.CHECK_ENVIRONMENT.done: The backend confirms the old receipt and released resources, starts one new check record for the same candidate/command, and records its actual outcome.
cleardevBlocker.RESOURCE.title: Storage, temporary capacity, or cleanup is blocking work
cleardevBlocker.RESOURCE.cause: A fixed resource allowance, real filesystem capacity/inodes, or an unreleased container reservation/lease may be preventing preparation. These are not the same as host RAM limits.
cleardevBlocker.RESOURCE.risk: Deleting run receipts, cache indexes, leases, or application databases can lose data or incorrectly authorize duplicate execution.
cleardevBlocker.RESOURCE.steps: Inspect the failing resource and its owner. Stop only a known disposable preview through its existing stop action; reclaim unrelated disposable storage only after identifying it. Let the application confirm cleanup. The shared 8 GiB reservation ceiling does not remove per-action limits or actual disk checks; it is not a general fix for unknown cleanup.
cleardevBlocker.RESOURCE.done: The exact resource is available and its prior owner has released it. Only an eligible, bounded retry proceeds; old receipts remain intact.
cleardevBlocker.INTEGRATION.title: Integration or candidate composition is blocked
cleardevBlocker.INTEGRATION.cause: Input candidates, their dependency evidence, composition, or the final integration check could not produce an accepted combined candidate.
cleardevBlocker.INTEGRATION.risk: Hand-merging and marking the run complete can bypass independent review and mix evidence from different input commits.
cleardevBlocker.INTEGRATION.steps: Inspect the exact input candidate IDs, conflict paths, composition result, and integration log. A genuine environment failure may use the existing bounded recovery; a conflict or failing combined candidate requires the supported rework path. Legacy parallel flows do not gain the generic project's recovery actions.
cleardevBlocker.INTEGRATION.done: A new correctly bound integration candidate passes the frozen integration checks and final review; no earlier PASS is copied.
cleardevBlocker.TRIAL.title: Final review or functional trial is incomplete
cleardevBlocker.TRIAL.cause: The final reviewer or required command/browser/HTTP trial has not supplied sufficient evidence for this exact candidate.
cleardevBlocker.TRIAL.risk: A running preview, screenshot, or HTTP 200 does not prove acceptance criteria passed. Repeating an unknown command trial may execute it twice.
cleardevBlocker.TRIAL.steps: Read the final review and the frozen trial steps. Supply the missing concrete information, then use the offered final-review retry where eligible. The bound reviewer must execute and record the original trial; users must not fabricate its receipt. Command preparation is retryable only under the proven-not-started, cleaned-up bounded rule.
cleardevBlocker.TRIAL.done: Each required trial has accurate candidate-bound evidence and final review accepts it. Starting or stopping a preview alone is insufficient.
cleardevBlocker.PREREQUISITE.title: A required earlier decision or delivery is still missing
cleardevBlocker.PREREQUISITE.cause: The plan, explicit execution admission, previous stage delivery, or delivery-readiness evidence is not complete. This may be an intentional wait rather than a fault.
cleardevBlocker.PREREQUISITE.risk: Skipping a predecessor or assuming that a saved plan authorizes execution starts work on an unapproved or incorrect baseline.
cleardevBlocker.PREREQUISITE.steps: Finish the displayed predecessor or specification decision first. For a saved generic-project plan, review it under Requirement and result actions and explicitly start project execution. For a next stage, select the actual delivered result and its data baseline. Do not select a local Builder candidate as a completed delivery.
cleardevBlocker.PREREQUISITE.done: The missing prerequisite is recorded through its normal operation and the next stage's current binding becomes ready.
cleardevBlocker.DATA.title: The delivered application's startup or data version needs attention
cleardevBlocker.DATA.cause: Startup, health checking, data preparation/migration, or the selected persistent-data version could not be validated.
cleardevBlocker.DATA.risk: Deleting application data, editing a selected-version pointer, or implicitly downgrading can lose or corrupt user records. Health alone is not migration correctness.
cleardevBlocker.DATA.steps: Use Requirement and result actions to inspect the exact delivered candidate and startup error. Stop only that preview before investigating ports or data. Keep both the original data and any failed migration copy. Open the required intermediate delivery to prepare its data when instructed; select the current delivered data baseline rather than forcing an old one.
cleardevBlocker.DATA.done: The correct version starts, health is verified, and the user checks retained data and new behavior before selecting it as the next-stage baseline.
cleardevBlocker.STOPPED.title: The workflow was deliberately stopped or its direction changed
cleardevBlocker.STOPPED.cause: Cancellation, pause, a direction decision, or another terminal stop prevents the old operation from proceeding.
cleardevBlocker.STOPPED.risk: Forcing the old step open can act against the user's latest decision and apply obsolete specifications or permissions.
cleardevBlocker.STOPPED.steps: Inspect the latest cancellation/pause/direction decision and its binding. Follow only the supported current direction or resume operation. Do not reopen a cancelled requirement or clear the stop in the database; keep its files and failure history for reference.
cleardevBlocker.STOPPED.done: A supported current decision explicitly establishes the next permitted work. A generic recovery request cannot reverse cancellation.
cleardevBlocker.CAPABILITY.title: The requested workflow is outside current supported capability
cleardevBlocker.CAPABILITY.cause: The runtime, dependency form, task structure, legacy policy, or requested work mode is not supported by this execution contract.
cleardevBlocker.CAPABILITY.risk: Adding a permission exception or changing a frozen contract in place can bypass the evidence and isolation the workflow depends on.
cleardevBlocker.CAPABILITY.steps: Read the exact unsupported capability and preserve the existing work. Use the ordinary product/specification process for a genuinely different supported plan, or implement and validate the missing ClearDev capability separately. A legacy policy cannot be added retroactively to make an old run eligible.
cleardevBlocker.CAPABILITY.done: A supported, explicitly confirmed contract is in place. Repeated retries cannot add a missing capability.
cleardevBlocker.REGISTERED.title: A continuation is registered but not yet sent
cleardevBlocker.REGISTERED.cause: The recovery request is durable, while session restoration or preflight has not yet allowed its original next message.
cleardevBlocker.REGISTERED.risk: Creating a new registration wastes identity and can conflict with the existing one. A saved request is not proof of a send.
cleardevBlocker.REGISTERED.steps: Read the existing recovery history and resolve its specific session/preflight issue. Use Continue the registered step; it reuses the stored request ID, target and explanation. Do not edit or replace that request to bypass the remaining attempt limit.
cleardevBlocker.REGISTERED.done: The same registered continuation receives one confirmed send without a second registration or reset budget.
cleardevBlocker.UNKNOWN.title: The cause still needs diagnosis
cleardevBlocker.UNKNOWN.cause: This reason is not classified, or the stored record does not identify a specific cause. No network, configuration, or user fault is inferred.
cleardevBlocker.UNKNOWN.risk: Guessing that an unknown stop is a transient environment fault can repeat work, lose files, or bypass a deliberate safety stop.
cleardevBlocker.UNKNOWN.steps: Keep the original input and work directory. Refresh and inspect the displayed reason, fact IDs, session, check output and decision history. Report the precise missing evidence for a product-level diagnosis. Do not fill in 'repaired' without knowing what changed, and do not delete state to unlock the task.
cleardevBlocker.UNKNOWN.done: The failure is tied to concrete evidence and an existing safe next operation, or the unsupported recovery is explicitly identified for repair.
cleardevRecheck.title: Latest original-step recheck
cleardevRecheck.help: Context is optional. The program checks the original session, unsent message, work directory and configuration before continuing. Leaving this empty records the neutral system request shown below; it does not assert that you repaired anything.
cleardevRecheck.defaultContext: System request: check the original Builder and continue its exact unsent task if safe; no environment repair or task completion is claimed.
cleardevRecheck.registered: The original-step recheck is registered. Continue this registration after a disconnect; do not create another request for the same stop.
cleardevRecheck.waiting: The request is saved; the program has not yet confirmed a recheck result.
cleardevRecheck.pending: A recheck has started. This is not a task send or a successful recovery.
cleardevRecheck.ready: Prerequisite checks passed at the recorded time. Actual delivery still uses the original sender and budget; task checks and review remain required.
cleardevRecheck.failed: The recheck stopped before a new task send and its failure is saved. Inspect its recorded stage and cause. Existing work is retained; this receipt does not trigger another send.
cleardevRecheck.historical: Saved check history, not current permission to continue.
cleardevRecheck.stage.WORKSPACE: Original work directory and saved edits
cleardevRecheck.stage.PREFLIGHT: Original tool, model and account preflight
cleardevRecheck.stage.READY: Prerequisites checked; original sender remains responsible
cleardevRecheck.unknownStage: Unrecognized check stage; inspect the saved code
cleardevRecheck.reason.BUILDER_SESSION_B: The original worker is not idle, or a durable/native turn is still unfinished. Inspect that turn and wait for its confirmed end; this request will not interrupt or queue over it.
cleardevRecheck.reason.BUILDER_RECHECK_E: The program could not read the original session or its exact preflight evidence. Restore read access and recheck; missing evidence is not proof that a turn ended.
cleardevRecheck.reason.BUILDER_RESTORE_U: A previous restoration started without a confirmed usable session. This request does not restore again automatically. Inspect the original session, then explicitly request another safe recheck if it is still unsent.
cleardevRecheck.reason.BUILDER_RESTORE_N: Restoration did not return the original native conversation. Keep the work; do not substitute an unrelated chat. Inspect the original tool's resume support.
cleardevRecheck.reason.BUILDER_RESTORE_I: The session, model, native conversation or work directory changed during restoration. Keep the saved work and reconcile the original identity before rechecking.
cleardevRecheck.reason.BUILDER_RECHECK_R: The session changed or became busy between checking and reserving the message. No new delivery boundary was admitted. Recheck the original step after confirming the session state.
cleardevRecheck.reason.BUILDER_RESTORE_F: The native resume operation failed without a recognized error category. Inspect the original tool's error; do not guess that credentials or permissions need changing.
cleardevRecheck.reason.NATIVE_SESSION_RE: The original tool could not resume its saved conversation. Check that its original conversation record remains available. Do not create a replacement chat or clear the working directory through this retry.
cleardevRecheck.reason.NATIVE_SESSION_HI: The tool cannot provide the original conversation history needed to verify a safe continuation. Restore that history/read capability; this request will not manufacture it.
cleardevPlanner.help: Answers clarify these questions within the confirmed specification. A change in product intent still requires discussion and confirmation.
cleardevPlanner.recorded: Answers recorded. Continue to check the original planning request.
cleardevPlanner.unknown: Submission outcome is unknown. Retry uses the same request and answers.
cleardevPlanner.unavailable: Planning cannot continue yet. Check the current specification, source and original Planner; then refresh.
cleardevPlanner.limit: Two answer continuations have been used for this specification. Resolve any remaining product intent through discussion and confirmation; the previous answers and budget are retained.
cleardevPlanner.source: The specification or selected project source changed. Open the current stage and resolve that change before continuing.
cleardevPlanner.session: The original Planner is unavailable or has an unfinished turn. Resolve its session or tool status, then refresh. The saved answers are retained.
cleardevPlanner.evidence: The original question or delivery evidence could not be verified. Inspect the original Planner conversation; refresh after the evidence is available.
cleardevPlanner.stopped: This requirement is stopped. Resume it through its existing controls before continuing planning.
cleardevPlanner.direction: A direction change is pending. Complete that process before answering the old plan.
cleardevPlanner.login: Sign in to the selected tool, then continue the recorded answers.
cleardevPlanner.model: Restore availability of the project’s selected model, then continue the recorded answers.
cleardevPlanner.quota: Restore the selected account’s quota, then continue the recorded answers.
cleardevPlanner.rate: Wait for the selected provider’s rate limit to clear, then continue the recorded answers.
cleardevPlanner.tooLong: Keep all answers within 10,000 characters in total.
humanDecision.confirmExtraPlanningAttemp: Authorize one extra discussion or compilation attempt
humanDecision.extraPlanningAttemptSummar: Two original attempts failed. Authorize one additional original message, then continue the same request separately.
cleardevRecovery.extraRequest: Request one extra attempt (decide in the native window)
cleardevRecovery.extraRequestHelp: Only a supported original discussion or compilation with two confirmed failed attempts can request this allowance. The original input, session, attempts and message counts remain recorded. Approval permits one extra original request; it does not continue the step or confirm a specification.
cleardevRecovery.extraPending: The extra-attempt request is saved. Decide in the native window. Approval adds the allowance only; continuing the original step still requires a separate explicit action.
cleardevRecovery.extraRejected: The extra attempt was rejected. No allowance was added and the original step remains stopped. Original failures and work are retained.
cleardevRecovery.extraConsumed: This original step has used its one extra attempt. No fourth attempt is available; its input, counts and failure history remain recorded.
cleardevRecovery.extraContinueDiscussion: Use the authorized attempt to continue this discussion
cleardevRecovery.extraContinueCompilatio: Use the authorized attempt to compile the original stage
cleardevRecovery.extraContinueHelp: The extra original request is authorized. Continue explicitly in the same original session and with the same input. This spends that single allowance, grants no new format correction and does not approve a specification or start development.
cleardevRecovery.extraRequestHistory: Extra discussion or compilation attempt requested
cleardevRecovery.extraRequestHistoryNoti: This records an allowance request and its original failure. It is not approval, continuation, specification confirmation or completed work.
humanDecision.builderReplacementSummary: Replace the lost Builder for the original task without changing its code, history or budgets.
cleardevReplacement.title: Worker handoff
cleardevReplacement.explanation: Request the exact handoff and decide in the native window, then continue explicitly after authorization. The original task, code, history and budget remain bound to this work.
cleardevReplacement.request: Request a replacement worker (decide in the native window)
cleardevReplacement.continue: Continue with the authorized replacement worker
cleardevReplacement.requestHelp: Preserve the original task, code, history and budget. This requests a native decision; it does not create a new worker or send the task.
cleardevReplacement.continueHelp: The exact handoff is authorized. Continue explicitly to create the replacement in a separate managed directory and send the original task through its existing budget and checks.
cleardevReplacement.pending: Replacement requested. Decide in the native window. No new worker has been created and the task has not continued.
cleardevReplacement.rejected: The replacement was rejected. The original code and history remain preserved.
cleardevReplacement.registered: The handoff is recorded. This does not establish that a new worker took over or that the task message was sent. Continue using this same record.
cleardevReplacement.consumed: This original step has used its single replacement. Inspect the recorded worker and message; another replacement cannot be requested.
cleardevReplacement.lossUnconfirmed: The original worker has not been confirmed lost. Preserve the code and inspect its exact session and turns; an unavailable probe or missing record cannot authorize replacement.
cleardevReplacement.operationPending: An original-worker operation is still pending. Reconcile that operation before requesting a replacement; this entry does not stop the worker to manufacture a loss.
cleardevReplacement.requestHistoryNotice: This records the handoff request and original stop. It is not approval, a created worker, a sent task or completed work.
cleardevReplacement.state.PENDING_DECISI: Waiting for your native decision. No new worker has been created or sent the task.
cleardevReplacement.state.APPROVED_AWAIT: Handoff authorized. Continue explicitly; approval alone creates no worker and sends no task.
cleardevReplacement.state.REGISTERED: Handoff recorded. Inspect its saved stage; registration alone is not evidence of takeover or delivery.
cleardevReplacement.state.CREATE_FAILED: Creating the replacement did not finish. Inspect the saved cause; the original code and this handoff remain recorded.
cleardevReplacement.state.COPY_FAILED: Restoring the saved code into the replacement directory did not finish. Preserve both directories and inspect the saved cause.
cleardevReplacement.state.UNKNOWN: The external result is unknown. Reconcile the same recorded worker and message; do not create another worker or resend the task.
cleardevReplacement.state.HANDED_OFF: The new worker has taken over the recorded task message. The original checks and independent review still apply.
cleardevReplacement.state.REJECTED: The handoff was rejected. The original code and history remain preserved.
cleardevReplacement.unknownState: This handoff state is not recognized. Inspect the saved code; no success is inferred.
cleardevReplacement.historical: This saved handoff does not grant permission to continue the current task.
cleardevReplacement.oldCheck: The original worker's check is historical for this handoff. Its READY result does not establish that the replacement was created or took over.
cleardevReplacement.preserved: Original code and history remain preserved. Ignored caches stay in the original directory; this handoff does not copy the whole runtime environment.
cleardevRecovery.coordinationHelp: Use only the unused second attempt of the original coordination request. Keep the STOP and consumed messages. This does not add a coordination round, expand the contract, or grant human approval.
cleardevRecovery.coordinationRegistered: Original coordination recovery recorded. Continue the same request without spending another attempt.
cleardevRecovery.sourceChanged: The coordination source or frozen context changed. Refresh before continuing.
cleardevRecovery.sessionUnavailable: The original Planner session cannot be safely resumed. Check its identity and native history.
cleardevRecovery.extraCoordinationHelp: Request a native desktop decision only. No message is sent before human approval. Approval allows round 3 for this exact event; prior STOPs and usage remain. Task, review and revision budgets do not increase.
cleardevRecovery.extraCoordinationPendin: Waiting for a native desktop decision. No extra coordination has been authorized or sent.
cleardevRecovery.extraCoordinationRecord: Request recorded. Consult the native desktop decision and current progress for its authorization and coordination result.
cleardevRecovery.extraCoordinationReject: Extra coordination was rejected. Original stops and budgets remain; no automatic new request.
cleardevRecovery.extraCoordinationGrante: One extra coordination was approved on the native desktop; the original limit remains in history
cleardevRecovery.stoppedCheckHelp: Requests a native desktop decision only. Approval permits one retry of the unavailable check on the same candidate, followed by the original checks and reviews. The Planner STOP, spent task counter and role budgets remain. No Builder or Planner resend, command change or larger resource limit is authorized.
cleardevRecovery.stoppedCheckPending: Awaiting the native desktop decision; check recovery is not yet authorized.
cleardevRecovery.stoppedCheckRejected: Same-candidate check recovery was rejected; the stop and budgets remain.
cleardevRecovery.stoppedCheckRecorded: The check recovery request is recorded. Authorization, execution and results follow current facts.
cleardevRecovery.stoppedCheckGranted: Original STOP preserved. Same-candidate check recovery was authorized by the human; this is not a check or final-review PASS.
